svg.title: The 23-bit Progress Value Pack inside a 32-bit unsigned carrier: percent in bits 0 to 6, lang in 7 to 11, what in 12 to 15, level in 16 to 18, pass in 19 to 20 and passes in 21 to 22, both stored as value minus 1, bits 23 to 31 unused; the slots are ordered widest first, equal widths in declaration order. Below it the wire: the pack id, then the 23 bits as 3 little-endian bytes. Below that three lanes - a C# partial struct over uint Value with a property per field, a Java int tagged @Progress with static get and set groups, and a TypeScript number with a merged namespace - all reading and writing the same bytes.
svg.text: slots: widest first (7, 5, 4, 3, 2, 2); equal widths keep declaration order
one integer, no object: the same bytes in every language
